issue_context.title: SSL_set1_initial_peer_addr(SSL *s, const BIO_ADDR *addr) may read outside of buffer
comments: there should be third option to fix it: we can let `BIO_lookup_ex()` to fix result obtained from `getsockaddr()`. the idea is to reallocate `ai_addr` member so its size will match `BIO_ADDR`.
This is just a bug in ossl_quic_conn_set_initial_peer_addr(). It should never dereference peer_addr like this and instead use BIO_ADDR_copy().
